actions.action: Move plant to brightest south- or west-facing window with direct sun
Stake the plant gently if the lean persists
Water thoroughly until it drains when soil is fully dry
Empty standing water from the decorative pot
Slide plant out of pot and inspect roots
If roots are rotten, trim them and repot in fresh gritty soil
Inspect under leaves and along stems for mealybugs or mildew
If mealybugs found, dab with isopropyl alcohol on a cotton swab
If powdery mildew found, treat with a fungicide

reason: The answer blames low light as the main cause and treats the drought only as secondary stress. It never suggests soaking or bottom-watering the soil that isn't absorbing water. It also tells the owner to keep the failing watering routine and wait weeks, which delays the fix.
